source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20. NOTE: this batch's WebFetch tool was blocked by an org-level network egress policy for nearly every external domain needed (screener.in, all company IR sites, financial news sites) — not just bseindia.com as anticipated. All 20 entries below are confidence:Low, built from WebSearch result snippets rather than direct AR PDF reads. See PR description for details and recommended next steps.

inr_exposure.evidence: International revenue (INR 4,236 cr of INR 7,896 cr total FY25 revenue, ~54%) implies meaningful foreign-currency exposure, but no specific USD % or hedging policy was found.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export/international revenue estimated at ~7.6% of consolidated FY25 net sales (INR 993.22cr of INR 13,094cr) — modest FX revenue exposure; no hedging policy disclosure found.

ENDURANCE.extraction_note: WebFetch blocked for endurancegroup.com and screener.in, so the FY2024-25 Annual Report PDF ('Expanding Horizons') could not be opened directly. Geography split and other figures compiled from WebSearch snippets referencing segment/earnings data, not the AR text itself. Note: search results indicate Endurance completed the sale of its Veicoli Srl (Italy) subsidiary in August 2026, which post-dates the FY24-25 report and would change the Europe revenue mix going forward.

govt_capex.evidence: HAL is a Maharatna PSU under the Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India, with FY25 revenue composed of 23% manufacturing, 70% repair/overhaul (ROH), and the remaining 7% split between exports and design & development (D&D). The manufacturing+ROH portion (93%) is sold almost entirely to the Indian Air Force, Army and Navy, i.e. Government-of-India-funded. Order book of Rs 1,84,000 crore as of 31 March 2025 includes only Rs 490 crore of export orders. Note: the 7% figure bundles exports with D&D revenue, so the true export-only share is somewhat lower than 7%.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Forex fluctuation risk on procurement of imported items/components is contractually passed through to HAL's customers (Indian Air Force, Army, Navy) on an actual basis under variable-price contracts, insulating margins from currency and raw-material price escalation. HAL also pursues indigenisation to cut import dependence (searches cite 2,021 items indigenised, yielding forex savings of ~Rs 126 crore/year).
inr_exposure.evidence: Same as hedging_policy text above, per search-summarized company/analyst commentary.
